args: awk '/^## Install/{f=1} !f && /mcp__|Bash\(|Claude Code|Codex|dsh|Pi /{print FILENAME":"NR": "$0; bad=1} END{exit bad}' skill/SKILL.md

set -euo pipefail; fm=$(awk 'NR==1&&/^---$/{f=1;next} f&&/^---$/{exit} f' skill/SKILL.md); for k in name description whenToUse; do echo "$fm" | grep -qE "^$k:" || { echo "missing frontmatter key $k"; exit 1; }; done
set -euo pipefail; n=$(wc -l < skill/SKILL.md); echo "SKILL.md lines: $n"; test "$n" -le 300
set -euo pipefail; for f in tiers routing-record composition eval-harness dataset registry; do n=$(wc -l < "skill/references/$f.md"); echo "$f: $n"; test "$n" -ge 40; done

evidence_required: wc -l of SKILL.md and every reference file.
objective: Write the harness-neutral skill: SKILL.md with frontmatter and the tier-drop procedure, and six reference documents.

outputs.purpose: What each tier is for, what disqualifies it, structural skips.
Panel, cascade, draft and embedding-helper patterns.
Metric vector, held-out split, EvalRun to Disqualification, strict review default.
Attempt records as dataset rows, rights by purpose, export, tier-5 candidate families.
Registry fields, deployments, measured QoS, model names as configuration.

risk_controls: Harness names appear only under ## Install; model names only when labelled indicative as of 2026-10-19.
Rust by default; strict TypeScript only in adapters/dsh; no Python and no authored .js, .mjs or .cjs files.
No secret, phone number, account identifier or internal hostname in any file; run gitleaks protect --staged --redact before each commit.
Never write the owner's private organisation name (search pattern O[K]OA) or the forbidden owner-framing phrase (search pattern needs[ ]you) into any file; plain, specific prose.
Work only in the slice's worktree and branch; never touch main.
steps: skill/SKILL.md with frontmatter name: model-tier-drop, description (one sentence, when to use), whenToUse, metadata: { version: "0.1.0", harnesses: [claude-code, codex, dsh, pi, any] }. Body sections, in this order: The rule (five tiers, embeddings are helpers, QoS gate, ranking order, strict review default); Before you route (write the task record with floors first, copy the registry, check rights); Procedure (numbered: load in-force disqualifications; plan → candidates; execute each candidate through your harness; record every attempt including failures and abstentions; when the plan says the tier is done, let attempt record assess disqualification; decide; append nothing by hand); Composition patterns (panel, cascade, draft, embedding helpers, with when to use each); Records you leave behind (routing decision, attempts, disqualifications, eval runs, with the ledger paths); Eval harness and datasets (pointer to references); Install (CLI via cargo install --path crates/cli; hosted MCP URL and how to add it in Claude Code, Codex, dsh, Pi; skill symlink paths per harness). Keep SKILL.md under 300 lines; detail goes in references.

References: references/tiers.md (what each tier is for, what disqualifies it, examples of structural skips), references/routing-record.md (every RoutingDecision field with meaning), references/composition.md, references/eval-harness.md (metric vector, held-out split by source family with the hash rule, EvalRun → Disqualification, strict review default and the sampled exception with its conditions), references/dataset.md (attempt record as dataset row, rights by purpose, export, what a tier-5 candidate family looks like: high volume, stable, pass rate, sample size), references/registry.md (registry fields, how to add a deployment, QoS fields and that they are measured values, model names are configuration).
Wording rules: plain and specific; never the forbidden owner-framing phrase (pattern needs[ ]you); harness names only in Install; model names only when labelled indicative as of 2026-10-19.
